sources.creator: Photographer unidentified
sources.researchNote: The file page dates the photograph to the “early 1900s”, which cannot be right: Schlechter was born in 1904 and the sitter is a man of about thirty. The dress, the round spectacles and his age place the sitting in the nineteen-thirties, the decade of his work for Polish film and cabaret, and the likeness is dated here by decade rather than from the file page.

media.title: Emanuel Schlechter — publicity portrait
media.description: Publicity portrait of the Lwów-born lyricist and screenwriter Emanuel Schlechter, who wrote the Polish words sung to Kaper’s “San Francisco”.
media.altText: Head-and-shoulders portrait of a young man in round spectacles, dark suit and patterned tie, turned slightly to his right.
media.rightsNote: Public domain. The file page names no photographer and states that the photograph is out of copyright, under the term of the author’s life and seventy years; attribution to the source is retained.
